text:
Priya (Partnerships): Quick check-in 1: our trainer rehearsal for the SI onboarding is Thu 10am PT. Need to confirm HW passthrough, marketplace demo flow, and APAC localization notes.
Dmitri (SI Program): Count me in. Is this the one where we simulate a bad model rollout and a canary rollback?
Hannah (Training Ops): Yep  and we'll run the cert exam in the afternoon slot. Need proctor assignments and the exam VM snapshot.
Kai (Hardware PM): HW partner (NuviaGrid) can provide 2x T4 for demos and one A30 for stress. They'll need the lab manifest and MAC allowlist.
Leo (DevEx): I can produce the ephemeral lab manifests. Send the SI list and MACs. Also will demo the supplier onboarding API and the marketplace schema.
Priya (Partnerships): Also want to validate the marketplace content localization: Chinese/Japanese strings and screenshots for APAC partners. Who owns translations?
Hannah (Training Ops): We have a small localization budget. I can arrange translated slides + localized lab instructions. Need translations by Wed EOD to bake into the slides.
Dmitri (SI Program): Action plan: Dmitri -> roster + VPN exceptions; Priya -> confirm NuviaGrid nodes and PO; Kai -> MAC allowlist; Leo -> demo slides + API snippet; Hannah -> translations + proctors.
lms-bot: Reminder: upload training materials to the cohort page: https://intranet.redwood/lms/si-cohort-2026. Auto-send consent form enabled.
legal-bot: Heads-up: SIs in APAC require a localized DPA addendum. Legal reviewing template A2. ETA Tue noon.
Priya (Partnerships): Noted. If legal needs changes we may have to redact certain lab datasets. Keep the canary demo on synthetic data only.
Leo (DevEx): Example API snippet I'll demo (will include in playbook):
```bash
# demo: publish supplier listing (sandbox)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/marketplace/v1/suppliers \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST_KEY" \
  -d '{"name":"IntegratorCo","region":"apac","artifact_url":"https://s3.redwood/test-sample.zip"}'
```
Hannah (Training Ops): Proctor rota: we need 1 proctor per 6 candidates. With 18 SIs, that's 3 proctors. I can cover two sessions, need one more volunteer.
Dmitri (SI Program): I'll cover one session. Also flagging two SIs that need hardware access escalation (tenant limits). @Kai can you confirm priority?
Kai (Hardware PM): Will bump them to priority on NuviaGrid. Need tenant IDs and start/end windows.
Priya (Partnerships): For the rehearsal, we'll do a 30m run of the marketplace listing + 20m canary rollback + 20m cert Q&A. Hannah, add rehearsal to invites and include localization checks.
Hannah (Training Ops): Done. Rehearsal invite sent to roster. Also uploading the trainer cheat-sheet to the playbook under "Trainer Rehearsal v0.9".
lms-bot: Trainer cheat-sheet uploaded: https://intranet.redwood/lms/playbooks/trainer-rehearsal-v0.9.pdf
Dmitri (SI Program): One more ask: can we include a short scoring rubric in the exam VM as a README so proctors have consistent pass/fail criteria?
Hannah (Training Ops): Yes  I'll add the rubric and 3 sample scenarios (marketplace listing, private deployment, emergency rollback).
legal-bot: Reminder: do not include any customer PII in the lab dataset. Use synthetic records only.
Priya (Partnerships): If the NuviaGrid PO doesn't clear we'll fallback to shared cloud instances. Notify me immediately if any hardware holds.
Leo (DevEx): Will add a short troubleshooting snippet in the playbook for testing network egress and KMS access.
Priya (Partnerships): Great, closing loop: I'll post a final checklist here Wed morning. Thanks all :sparkles:
